The shop is well known for its variety of sweets, desserts, and traditional delicacies, and during festive seasons or special occasions, the place becomes very lively and crowded. You will find many options like halwa, malpua, phirni, mithai, and other dessert items, which attract a lot of visitors.

featured_reviews.name: palak desai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience. I ordered kachoris expecting premium quality given the price ₹400 for 500g and even paid an additional ₹200 for delivery because I trusted the brand. Unfortunately, the kachoris were clearly not fresh — the stuffing was sticky from inside and had an unpleasant smell.

What made it worse was the response from the owner, he did acknowledge the issue and blamed the heat, but that explanation doesn’t make sense — fresh kachoris made in the morning don’t spoil by midday.  I was asked to send the entire order back at my own cost for a replacement — meaning I would have to spend another ₹400 on delivery alone, which is completely unreasonable.

For a brand charging premium prices, basic quality and customer service should not be compromised. Very disappointing and not worth the money.

I have attached the bill to clarify that I placed the order carefully and it was definitely from your listing, not from any other shop. So there seems to be some confusion in your response.
I’m simply sharing my genuine experience as a customer, especially considering the premium pricing and additional delivery cost I incurred. I hope you take this feedback constructively.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Mam we regret for what has happened with you as we were not available 
The staff was managing the shop as we were not available as our mother had passed away 
We will try to satisfy you next time 
Thank you for your feedback

featured_reviews.name: swayambharat
featured_reviews.review_text:
Focused... only way to describe this place.
ONE outlet. Serving just TWO items... Jalebi n Fafda… for over a HUNDRED YEARS!!!

Thats Mumbadevi Jalebiwala for you.
Located next to Mumbadevi Temple in Kalbadevi, been churning out mouthwatering Jalebis made in Pure Ghee thru the day, down the years from their small humble shop which can barely seat about 20.
Theres no menu card nor a word spoken.
Just walk in, take a seat and you are instantly served a plate of fresh piping 4/5 Jalebis n Fafdas.
Max turnaround time is 5-6 mts as wave after wave of faithfuls silently wade in and out all thru the day.
In full view near the entrance, the Maharaj (Chef) can barely keep up with the unending stream of customers who want to eat this delicacy and take away too!
Unchanged since they opened in 1897, its only recently that the 4th Generation of owners opened new outlets (4 as of now) in the suburbs, and thankfully, just like them, quality remains unchanged!

When we complained- He said I am the owner and it’s my store I do what I like . I believe they could be cooking this so famous food in the toilet. So be very careful before purchasing this brand. Years of trust broken. Also, the staff is exceptionally rude & the prodcut quality is sub standard poor like the owner’s behaviour and hygiene of the store. Even a road side vendor does better than this store. On an average we would consume - 3-4 Dozens in a quarter * 5 families. Thats lost & never am I recommending this brand to anyone. Nor are we going to distribute their Rasgullas on occasions to relatives. Cancel this brand & boycott them until they fix their hygiene and care for consumers

featured_reviews.name: Parin Chheda
featured_reviews.review_text: Despite the positive reputation of Bhaishankar's Rasgullas, my recent experiences have been disappointing. Over the past several orders, I have noticed a decline in the quality of the rasgullas I have received. Fresh rasgullas are typically soft, white, and do not break easily, but the ones I have received have been stale, hard, and prone to breaking. While Bhaishankar's was once known for their exceptional rasgullas, I regret to say that I can no longer recommend them and will not be purchasing from them again.

featured_reviews.name: CA Anupa Gharat
featured_reviews.review_text: Purchased 2 kala jamun and this sweet for 108 rupees and was served in this box. All the sweet syrup leaked. How pathetic!😢 Charging exorbitantly more than other local stores and still this kind of service offered.

featured_reviews.name: meghna bamb
featured_reviews.review_text:
The best rasmalais and rasgullas that we have eaten so far!
We had ordered for kesar rasmalai..it's fluffy n light and perfect sweetened.
The big size rasgullas look so inviting...and then after tasting..u keep wanting more! Soft n yummy!
Both are a must must have!

featured_reviews.name: S S
featured_reviews.review_text: The Bengali sweets are true vfm. The rasgullas are one of the best you can get in Mumbai. Funny they don't accept cards or digital payments even today. The staff is very stingy when it comes to giving a rubber band to fasten a bag of rasgulla so much so that i had to tell them that i will pay extra for it if it is so much of an issue. I had a very bad experience in the past when the syrup leaked in my bag & ruined almost 3k worth of goods. 4* only for the merchandise.

featured_reviews.review_text: It’s definitely a brand name till now but now they are not sale us fresh sweet jut I bought a milk cake they gave me full dry I came back and complain about it. But they not agree. I suggest u all pls don’t buy expect Bengali sweet.
